vibes.doom: Focus on concerning trends, security vulnerabilities, layoffs, technical debt, and industry problems. Be pessimistic but informative.
vibes.hopeful: Highlight innovations, new tools, career opportunities, and positive developments. Be optimistic and encouraging.
vibes.snarky: Add dry wit and mild cynicism. Point out hype vs reality. Be entertaining but informative.
vibes.neutral: Objective, balanced summary without emotional coloring. Just the facts.
